metaShifts.theme: Facet System Removal and Innate Standardization
metaShifts.description: The complete removal of Facets and standardization of innate abilities represents a fundamental shift toward simplified hero identity. All heroes now have single, defined innate abilities that scale predictably with levels rather than offering choice-based customization. This reduces strategic complexity in drafting but creates more consistent power curves.

The mechanical overhaul of healing systems creates new synergistic opportunities. Items like Sange, Kaya and Sange, and Orb of Corrosion now modify incoming healing, while the unified Health Restoration system affects all forms of life gain. This significantly buffs sustain-based strategies and heroes who can stack multiple healing amplification sources.

The shift from randomized to attribute-based enchantment selection creates predictable power spikes for specific hero types. Strength heroes get guaranteed access to Crude/Tough, Agility heroes to Nimble/Alert, and Intelligence heroes to Mystical/Keen-eyed. This reduces RNG variance while creating more defined neutral item scaling paths.

The introduction of Chasm Stone and its integration into Gleipnir and Shiva's Guard creates a new itemization axis. Heroes who can effectively utilize AoE bonuses gain significant power, while the Specialist's Array line provides ranged carries with new scaling options through secondary projectiles.

Systematic nerfs to Kaya-based items, Meteor Hammer, and other mana regen amplification sources reduce the sustainability of spell-heavy strategies. This particularly impacts heroes who relied on infinite mana pools for farming or teamfighting, forcing more careful resource management.

synergisticWinners.synergyExplanation: The new unified healing system allows Sange, Kaya and Sange, and Abyssal Blade to modify incoming healing. Heroes who build these items while having natural healing abilities (like Pudge, Abaddon, or Dragon Knight) can now stack multiple sources of healing amplification for massive sustain.

Heroes who naturally build Gleipnir or Shiva's Guard (like Magnus, Enigma, or Tidehunter) now gain +40/75 AoE from Chasm Stone integration. Combined with the new deterministic Enchantments, these heroes can reliably access additional AoE bonuses, creating massive teamfight presence.

The new Specialist's Array → Hydra's Breath progression provides ranged carries with secondary projectiles and max health damage. Heroes like Drow Ranger, Luna, or Gyrocopter can now scale into late game with percentage-based damage while maintaining their farming efficiency.

Intelligence heroes now have guaranteed access to Mystical enchantments at all tiers, providing consistent mana cost reduction and spell amplification scaling. This creates predictable power spikes for heroes like Invoker, Storm Spirit, or Tinker.

Strength heroes gain guaranteed access to Crude enchantments (Tiers 2-4), providing health restoration amplification and base attack time reduction. Combined with the new healing system, tanky heroes can become nearly unkillable while maintaining damage output.

synergisticLosers.synergyExplanation: The systematic nerfs to Kaya (-10%), Kaya and Sange (-10%), Yasha and Kaya (-10%), and Meteor Hammer (-5%) mana regen amplification destroy the infinite mana strategies. Heroes who relied on these items for sustained spell casting lose significant power.

Multiple illusion synergies have been removed: Broodmother's Incapacitating Bite, Abaddon's Curse of Avernus, and Terrorblade's Demon Zeal no longer work with illusions. This dismantles the core scaling mechanism for illusion-based carries.

The removal of randomized enchantments eliminates the ability to adapt neutral item builds based on available enchantments. Heroes who benefited from flexible enchantment access (like Universal heroes getting any enchantment) lose strategic depth.

The complete removal of Facets eliminates all choice-based hero customization. Strategies that relied on specific facet combinations or situational facet selection are completely removed from the game.
Both Refresher Orb and Refresher Shard no longer refresh item cooldowns, only ability cooldowns. This eliminates powerful combinations like double BKB, double Satanic, or double Abyssal Blade usage.

Carry.explanation: Despite Demon Zeal illusion nerfs, TB gains +1 base armor and stronger Conjure Image illusions (25/30/35/40% damage). The new healing amplification system synergizes with his high HP pool, and he can access guaranteed Brawny enchantments for consistent scaling.

Massive buffs across the board: +10 base damage, +20 attack speed, +5 movement speed, plus Feast becomes a basic ability with scaling. The new Ghoul Frenzy innate provides +5 attack speed per level, and he can infest Ancients by default.

Significant buffs to mobility and sustain: +5 movement speed, +0.5 base health regen, Shadow Step cooldown reduced and cast range increased. Illusion damage and survivability improved, while Haunt cooldown decreased.

Despite some nerfs, AM gains +1 base armor and Aghanim's Scepter upgrade for Mana Break (+1.5% max mana burned). Blink cooldown reduced at early levels, and the new healing system benefits his sustain in lane.

Mid.explanation: Orb max levels increased to 8, and Aghanim's Scepter now provides choice-based upgrades with +1 level to selected orb. This creates more flexible scaling paths and stronger late-game potential with higher orb levels.

New Deploy Turrets ability provides area control and farming, while Rearm cooldown decreased significantly (5.5/5/4.5s). March of the Machines gains healing for allies with Aghanim's Scepter, improving team utility.

Base damage and strength increased, while all abilities gain damage buffs. Arc Lightning base damage up, Lightning Bolt and Thundergod's Wrath provide better vision, and Static Field scales more consistently.

New Slow Burn innate provides 64% additional damage as burn over 4s on all abilities. Despite base damage nerfs, this creates massive sustained damage potential and synergizes with spell amplification items.

Offlane.explanation: New Leviathan's Catch innate provides permanent scaling through fish consumption (+3 max health, +2 attack range, +1 damage block per fish). Kraken Shell now provides strong dispel, and Anchor Smash scales with attack range.

Empower now always affects Magnus with 30% increased values and can't be self-cast, providing consistent self-buff. Base agility increased, and Solid Core provides more consistent slow resistance scaling.

New Horsepower innate grants 30% of strength as movement speed (doesn't stack with boots), providing massive mobility scaling. Strength gain increased to 4.2, creating exponential movement speed growth.

Reworked Outfight Them! provides stacking armor bonuses for LC and nearby allies. Moment of Courage becomes more reliable (triggers after set number of attacks), and Duel allows ability usage during duels.

SoftSupport.explanation: New Curiosity innate provides scaling damage, buff/debuff duration, and AoE bonuses. Stolen spells have 10/20/30% reduced cooldown, and Fade Bolt reduces both spell and attack damage by default.

Thunder Strike damage increased, and new Kinetic Fence (Aghanim's Shard) provides better area control. Electromagnetic Repulsion now scales with Intelligence for damage, improving his scaling potential.
New Aghanim's Scepter provides rotating Tarot Card buffs with powerful effects (+40% spell amp, +100% gold gain, +150% int, +40% heal amp, or damage barrier). Prognosticate now predicts Roshan timer.
New Eldwurm's Edda innate allows upgrading a basic ability to level 5 after 10 minutes, plus 25% base intelligence bonus. This creates unique scaling potential and ability customization.

HardSupport.explanation: New Glacial Guard innate converts 30% + 2% per level of mana spent into physical barriers. Arcane Aura now provides CM with 20/40/60/80% mana regen amplification, improving her sustainability.
New Sacrifice innate allows killing allied creeps for mana and experience, providing laning sustain and experience advantage. This creates strategic depth in lane management and resource generation.

Finger of Death gains empowered melee form by default (25% cleave, bonus damage, 30 movement speed for 20s). New To Hell and Back provides 20% debuff duration while enemies are dead and spell amp on respawn.
New Zealot innate spawns a scaling melee creep on respawn with Martyrdom ability and teleportation. Holy Persuasion can now unsummon creeps and increases all outgoing damage by 0/6/12/18%.
